messages:
maria: Listing day checklist — mapping press embargo windows + SI on-call rota + hardware SKU copy + storefront assets. Need owners and any blockers. Quick sync 15m at 9:30 PT? Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/marketplace-listing-checklist
jon: I can take press coord. Need embargo window confirmed from legal. @alex do you have timeline?
alex: Legal wants embargo 9:00 AM PT. Can confirm formally by EOD today. I'll update the doc.
lee: SI onboarding — we'll have APAC morning coverage. Need runbook & escalation matrix in the doc. Can someone paste runbook link here?
maria: Runbook is in the same doc under Appendix B: https://docs.google.com/document/d/marketplace-listing-checklist#runbook — includes pager+contacts. @alex please confirm ingress ports for SI agents so ops can validate.
alex: Confirmed ports: 443 and 5222. VPN certs rotate nightly. Not a blocker. Also I'll handle staging cutover. Deploy command we will run:```./cutover.sh --env=staging --tag=marketplace-v1```
sam: Marketing note: we need final hero image + 30s demo by 8:00 AM PT. @jon can we reuse last GIF or do we need a fresh render?
jon: Fresh logo lockups required for partner badges (legal). If marketing gets partner logos we'll reuse the GIF template. @lee can SI surface partner logos into assets?
lee: I'll pull logos from the partner portal and drop into the assets folder. ETA 5:15 AM PT.
pressbot: Reminder: embargo metadata must be populated in the press spreadsheet by 8:00 AM PT or we default to 'no embargo' for sends.
maria: Two blockers remaining: (1) legal confirmation (alex) (2) hero image final (sam). If both clear, plan is push to staging 08:45 PT and listing at 09:00 PT. Who's owner for staging cutover?
alex: I'll own staging cutover and watch logs. Ping me in #release-war-room at T-15. I'll also monitor model-serving traces and traffic.
jon: I'll coordinate the press send once Alex confirms staging health. I'll assemble press pack in the doc and share final link here.
lee: SI on-call roster added to Appendix C of the doc. Paging cadence and runbook steps are there. All good from SI side.
maria: Thanks everyone. If anything unexpected, escalate to me and @alex. :thumbsup:
